listings.title: Deep Learning for Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy
listings.description: Build and validate a CNN pipeline for grading retinal images, with attention to clinician-facing explainability and calibration on a public fundus dataset.
listings.outcomes:
Clean and split a public fundus dataset.
Train a CNN grader and compare it with a baseline.
Add saliency maps a clinician can read, and check calibration.
Write a short report and present a poster.
listings.skills: PyTorch, model evaluation, explainability methods, scientific writing

listings.title: Explainable AI for Clinical Decision Support
listings.description: Evaluate SHAP and counterfactual explanations for tabular clinical models against clinician feedback in a small user study.
listings.outcomes:
Review explanation methods for tabular clinical data.
Train a risk model on an open clinical dataset.
Build a small decision-support prototype with SHAP and counterfactual views.
Run a usability session with two clinicians and report what helped them.
listings.skills: Explainable AI, user studies, Python, Streamlit

listings.title: Federated Learning for Multi-Hospital Imaging Data
listings.description: Prototype a federated training loop across simulated hospital silos and measure the privacy and accuracy trade-off.
listings.outcomes:
Simulate three hospital data silos from a public imaging dataset.
Implement federated averaging and one privacy defence.
Measure the accuracy and privacy trade-off.
Present the results at the lab meeting.
listings.skills: Federated learning, differential privacy, experiment design

listings.title: Microbiome Diversity in Tropical Coral Reefs
listings.description: Sequence and analyse microbial communities from reef samples collected off Pulau Hantu to link diversity with bleaching resilience.
listings.outcomes:
Join two field trips to collect coral and water samples off Pulau Hantu.
Extract DNA and prepare 16S amplicon libraries.
Analyse diversity with QIIME 2 and relate it to bleaching surveys.
listings.skills: Field sampling, DNA extraction, bioinformatics, R

listings.title: CRISPR Screening for Antibiotic Resistance Genes
listings.description: Design a pooled CRISPR knockout screen to identify genes that change antibiotic sensitivity in E. coli.
listings.outcomes:
Design a guide RNA library against candidate resistance genes.
Run the pooled knockout screen under two antibiotics.
Count guides by sequencing and rank genes by effect.
listings.skills: Molecular cloning, CRISPR screening, sequencing analysis, lab safety

listings.title: Solid-State Battery Degradation Modelling
listings.description: Fit physics-informed degradation models to cycling data and predict remaining useful life for a lab cell.
listings.outcomes:
Clean cycling data from coin cells tested in the lab.
Fit an equivalent-circuit model and a physics-informed degradation model.
Predict remaining useful life and compare the two models.
listings.skills: Battery modelling, Python, curve fitting, uncertainty estimation

listings.title: Low-Power Edge Inference for Wearable ECG
listings.description: Quantise and deploy an arrhythmia classifier on a microcontroller, then measure latency and battery impact.
listings.outcomes:
Train a small arrhythmia classifier on the MIT-BIH dataset.
Quantise it and deploy it on a microcontroller.
Measure latency, accuracy and battery drain on the board.
listings.skills: Embedded C, TinyML, signal processing, power measurement

listings.title: Human-Robot Collaboration in Assistive Environments
listings.description: Study handover strategies between a collaborative arm and a human in a mock kitchen, measuring safety and comfort.
listings.outcomes:
Program three handover strategies on a collaborative robot arm.
Run a user study with 12 participants in the mock kitchen.
Analyse safety and comfort ratings and write up the findings.
listings.skills: ROS 2, robot programming, user study design, statistics

listings.title: Soft Gripper Design for Delicate Produce
listings.description: Iterate silicone finger geometries and evaluate grasp success on fruit of varied firmness.
listings.outcomes:
Design silicone finger geometries in CAD and cast them.
Test grasp success on fruit of different firmness.
listings.skills: CAD, moulding and casting, experimental testing

listings.title: Bayesian Methods for Sparse Sensor Networks
listings.description: Develop a hierarchical Bayesian model for missing readings in an air-quality network and validate on NEA data.
listings.outcomes:
Explore a year of air-quality readings and their missing values.
Build a hierarchical Bayesian model for the gaps.
Validate it against held-out NEA station data.
listings.skills: Bayesian statistics, Stan or PyMC, spatial data, R or Python

listings.title: NLP for Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
listings.description: Adapt a multilingual transformer to Malay and Tamil news text with a small annotated corpus and evaluate transfer.
listings.outcomes:
Annotate a small corpus of Malay and Tamil news headlines.
Fine-tune a multilingual transformer on it.
Test how well it transfers between the two languages.
Release the corpus and a short report.
listings.skills: NLP, Hugging Face Transformers, annotation design, evaluation

listings.title: Fair Ranking in Recommender Systems
listings.description: Measure exposure disparity in a movie recommender and implement two re-ranking methods to reduce it.
listings.outcomes:
Train a baseline movie recommender on MovieLens.
Measure how exposure is shared between popular and niche films.
Implement two re-ranking methods and compare fairness and accuracy.
listings.skills: Recommender systems, fairness metrics, PyTorch, experiment tracking
